name: 笑傲江湖 II
english_name: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer II (Xiao Ao Jiang Hu II)
english_description: The login screen calls this game "Virtual Life." It belongs to the "XO mudlib" engine family (descended from TMI-2/ES2, rewritten by "Falcon" in 1996), sharing lineage with this collection's Xiao Ao Jiang Hu Mini Edition and XO Final 1.2, but is an independent, later snapshot of the game — in-game notices show it opened on April 1, 2003.
